Then the Sandman comes out of nowhere and, sure enough, the girl falls asleep in the blink of an eye. Just then, she has a dream that she is in Toyland, where she encounters all kinds of fairy tale characters.

video.title: Popeye: Assault and Flattery
video.description: From The Public Domain Movie Database: Bluto is suing Popeye for assault. They both show the judge some scenes from some of their cartoon to prove their case.

video.title: Popeye: Bride and Gloom
video.description: Popeye and Olive are finally planning to get married. The plans change, though, after Olive has a dream where she sees their future kids and all the mischief they get into. You can find more information regarding this film on its IMDb page .

video.title: Popeye: Cooking With Gags
video.description: From The Public Domain Movie Database: Bluto plays all sorts of gags on Popeye and Olive on April Fool's Day.

video.title: Popeye: Floor Flusher
video.description: From The Public Domain Movie Database: Olive has a leaky faucet and Popeye does what he can to fix it while Bluto wreaks havoc on the basement pipes.

video.title: Popeye: Gopher Spinach
video.description: From The Public Domain Movie Database: Popeye tries to rid his garden of a gopher, in the end the gopher saves Popeye from a bull.

video.title: Popeye: Greek Mirthology
video.description: From The Public Domain Movie Database: Popeye tells his four nephews the story of his great Uncle Hercules in order to get them to eat spinach.

video.title: Popeye: The Paneless Window Washer
video.description: Popeye and Bluto are again competing against one another. Only this time, it's not for Olive Oyl's love, but for the privilege of being able to wash her windows. You can find more information regarding this film on its IMDb page .

video.title: Tom and Jerry: Barnyard Bunk
video.description: "The Great Depression has hit a rundown farm owned by a Farmer Alfalfalike farmer. As the old man sleeps on his porch, objects around him begin to break down. /.../ Just then saxophone salesmen Tom and Jerry happen by the farm. The farmer is indifferent to their music ("Aw, nuts!"), so the duo decide to show him how useful saxophones can be.

video.title: Tom and Jerry: Jolly Fish
video.description: Tom and Jerry go fishing. Van Beuren's "Tom and Jerry" series was renamed "Dick and Larry" in the 1950s. That's why the title card presents this cartoon as a "A Dick and Larry Carton".

video.title: Tom and Jerry: Redskin Blues
video.description: Plot taken from IMDb: Tom and Jerry find their wagon west attacked by Indians, but escape only after being rescued by all the branches of the military, including the Army's tanks. A cartoon with lots of music and action as well as ethnic stereotypes the 1930s way: "An unremarkable wild west cartoon is improved by the comedy of the unexpected.

video.title: Tom and Jerry: The Tuba Tooter
video.description: Plot taken from IMDb: A German "ohm-pah" trio is incomplete until their tuba player arrives on a boat from overseas. The resulting quartet brings the whole town out for a German dance party, until the police arrive to take the "tuba tooter" to jail.
